header.one_liner: Adani Defence & Aerospace is an Indian defence company with indigenous UAV manufacturing and Drishti 10 deliveries.

what_it_is.prose: Adani Defence & Aerospace documents indigenous UAV manufacturing, including the Drishti 10 Starliner. Its January 2024 release records handover of the first indigenously manufactured Drishti 10 to the Indian Navy; its annual-report material records delivery of the first Drishti 10 to the Indian Army.
